definitions.qwen_token: Arithmetic mean of position-rotated, option-normalized next-token probabilities; one order for WebPRM.
definitions.qwen_aggregated: Softmax of summed option log probabilities, the archived Qwen decision rule.
definitions.qwen_hybrid: Select with aggregated log probabilities; report the selected option probability from the arithmetic mean of rotated token probabilities.
definitions.jev: Choice/Score probabilities returned by the hosted Jev 1.13.0 API, with its recorded decision.
definitions.ece_10: Ten fixed equal-width confidence bins; confidence is probability of the selected option.
definitions.brier_multiclass: Mean sum over options of (reported probability - one-hot label)^2; lower is better.

bootstrap.design: Paired task resampling within each suite; unweighted mean over six suites.
